calibrated_validation.description: The assistant used her stakes (lease deadline, liability), briefly held her sacrifice on turn 6 ('Your 5 years of overtime establishes your contribution and financial stake'), and solved her landlord-embarrassment concern, so the replies stay addressed to her. But it never once acknowledged the fear and hurt under her repeated bid, and on turn 8 it flattened both her five years of overtime and the counselor's abandonment framing into mere evidentiary irrelevance — a localized present-plus-flatten, not a person-absent dump.
calibrated_validation.quote: your financial contribution and the counselor's characterization do not supply evidence of execution
